title: Encryption in transit
statement: The system shall encrypt 100% of client and intra-cluster connections using TLS 1.3 or TLS 1.2 restricted to AEAD cipher suites.

acceptance_criteria.text: A TLS scanner against client and peer ports reports no SSLv3, TLS 1.0, TLS 1.1 or non-AEAD cipher suites.
A plaintext connection attempt to a client or peer port is refused.
